why: meta-labeling (signal filtering) was never tested (grep: 0). R16d / R22 showed large differences between events, and the book improves only if the event sleeve's own Sharpe rises: a filter / sizer of individual event shorts is the direct way
trades: every v9.8 event-short trade (contiguous non-zero position of one coin in event_live.pnl; listing shorts and spot-delisting shorts), P&L = position x hourly return - funding - 10 bp per side
features (known at entry, the close befo: run-up: coin log return over the previous 24 h (or since its first close if shorter)
coin funding rate: last settlement before entry
BTC 30-day log return (daily closes to the previous day)
model: logistic regression (sklearn, L2, C = 1, standardised features), label = trade P&L > 0; walk-forward: a trade is scored by a model fit on trades that CLOSED before its entry, at least 60 of them, else multiplier 1

trials.A filter: keep the trade if p >= 0.5, else skip it
trials.B sizer: multiplier = clip(p / mean of the model's in-sample p, 0.5, 1.5)

implementation: candidate event sleeve = v9.8 event sleeve + sum over trades (multiplier - 1) x trade P&L (the gross cap is not re-applied; reported: correlation of the rebuilt trade sum with the real sleeve)
